source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.event_date_visible: Auction starts Sep 13, 2026 · 11:00 AM CDT · preview times Sept 7–12

classification.event_product_type: Themed auction (mancave: taxidermy, sports memorabilia, arcade, Americana) with in-person preview days

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Left third: black textured panel — seller name (gold) → MANCAVE AUCTION (distressed cream display type) → HOUSTON'S PREMIER CHOICE (red) → icon rows: auction start, address, phone → boxed preview times → red ribbon BID WITH CONFIDENCE → URL. Right two-thirds: ten extracted objects on white.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Framed US flag, zebra hide, bear mount, alligator head mount, arcade racing cabinet (centre), framed signed Elway jersey, jackalope and quail mounts, bronze cowboy group, 49ers helmet with gold chain. Light or no shadows; several objects float (flag, hide, mounts).
visual_read.composition_style: Dark information panel + white catalogue spread. Objects arranged as a loose grid with minimal overlap — a curated spread, not a room.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Distressed western/varsity display type for the title, matching the theme; sans for logistics; gold icons; red ribbon.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name top of panel; URL at the bottom of the panel; theme title dominates.
visual_read.cta_treatment: Red ribbon 'BID WITH CONFIDENCE' (reassurance, not urgency) plus the URL.
visual_read.footer_treatment: No band; the panel's bottom carries the URL.
visual_read.photographic_style: Extracted catalogue photography; mixed lighting across objects.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: None — spread layout; no gravity claim.

strongest_attributes: Themed display typography that truthfully matches the event (validates 'event-specific typography when truthful')
Dark panel used as a themed treatment while the merchandise field stays white
Breadth within the theme: taxidermy, memorabilia, arcade, bronze, Americana
Preview days and address handled as an organised logistics box
transferable_lessons: A catalogue-spread arrangement without gravity is an Owner-accepted family for themed / eclectic auctions — proposed as CATALOG_SCATTER, rationed, never the default
Themed typography is welcome when the theme is real; it must not spread to every word
Preview-day logistics for in-person events may use an icon-led block (missing from current rules)
A dark panel is acceptable for a themed event; the merchandise field remains light
do_not_generalize: Black textured panel, gold/red palette, western distressed type — event and seller identity
'Houston's Premier Choice', phone number, street address
Eight copy blocks — over the general budget
Floating objects without grounding must not leak into the scene families where the gravity rule is locked

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: All logistics live in one dark column; the white field stays clean, so density never touches merchandise.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Only allowed under an explicit LOGISTICS budget (in-person previews, address); general families remain at 5 blocks.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Spread / catalogue page. No world implied.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Not claimed; mounts and hides float; arcade cabinet and bronze sit lower, giving a mild sense of floor.
composition_assessment.depth: Mostly one plane with light overlaps (helmet chain over bronze, jersey over cabinet edge).
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Arcade cabinet as the central anchor; the rest roughly equal.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Bear and helmet touch the right edge; contained otherwise.

use_cases: events with preview days and an address
avoid_for: any campaign where a believable room is the intent

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
